name: step_channel_countdown_table
description: Decrements a per-channel countdown byte; when it reaches zero it reads the next duration from a table, ending the step if that value is zero. Otherwise it advances the channel's table index by two and adds a table entry to a second per-channel byte.

name: update_channel_envelope_step
description: Advances one channel's envelope and modulation state: it calls the countdown routine, scales a table value by a volume byte, applies optional sign and offset adjustments under flag bits, and stores the result as the channel's output word. When the step counter expires it reads the next pair of table entries and updates the channel's pointer and length fields.

name: reset_audio_channel_state
description: Clears five per-channel state bytes, then writes two values to a shared control word, first all bits set and then a low nibble, which the facts show as audio DMA and ADKCON register writes.

name: read_channel_sequence_bytes
description: Reads bytes from a channel's sequence stream until one exceeds the threshold. Bytes in the top range end the step and save the stream position, lower values are stored as note or instrument fields, and the middle range is dispatched through a handler table.

name: store_channel_header_and_parse
description: Stores the first byte of a sequence stream into a song-level field and then runs the same sequence byte loop that ends by saving the stream position.

name: store_channel_byte_and_parse
description: Stores the first byte of a sequence into a channel field and then runs the same sequence byte loop that ends by saving the stream position.

name: init_pitch_slide_and_parse
description: Stores a step value and a count into channel fields, clears the accumulator, and sets the slide flag, then parses the remaining sequence bytes. The update routine adds the step to the accumulator when the count reaches zero.

name: init_channel_oscillator_and_parse
description: Stores two header bytes as oscillator parameters, one used as a phase counter and one doubled as its range, sets the oscillator-enable flag, and then parses the remaining sequence bytes.

name: store_channel_param_and_parse
description: Stores the first sequence byte into a channel parameter field and then parses the rest of the sequence stream until the step ends.

name: tick_channel_sequence_timer
description: Counts down the channel's step timer; while it runs, a ramp flag moves a level byte up or down. When the timer expires it clears the transient flags and resumes parsing the channel's sequence from its saved position.

name: store_wave_index_and_parse
description: Stores the first sequence byte as a wave table index for the channel and then parses the rest of the stream. The envelope update routine uses this index to look up table entries.

name: store_song_byte_and_parse
description: Stores the first sequence byte into a song-level field and then parses the rest of the sequence stream until the step ends.

name: repeat_sequence_or_continue
description: Decrements the channel's repeat counter; while it stays non-zero, parsing restarts from the saved loop pointer, otherwise it continues from the current position.

name: store_song_param_and_parse
description: Stores the first sequence byte into a song-level parameter field and then parses the rest of the sequence stream until the step ends.

name: reset_step_and_save_position
description: When the channel's hold flag is clear, it zeroes the channel's extra counter, sets its start count and writes the channel's output byte. It then reloads the step timer from its saved value and stores the current stream position.

name: load_table_entry_into_channel
description: Looks up a table entry at the given index, saves the index in the channel's table position field, stores the looked-up value as the channel's current level, and sets its counter to one.

name: update_channel_sample_pointer_length
description: For a channel whose start delay is running, it counts the delay down, clamps a negative offset to zero on expiry, and writes the sample pointer and word length into the channel's audio hardware slot, then writes a DMA control value.

name: reset_and_load_channel_table
description: Clears the channel state table of sixteen records, marks two global bytes with a full-set sentinel value, then loads four channel start entries from a table selected by the argument, setting each channel's pointer, length and sentinel fields.

name: return_without_action
description: A single return instruction with no other work, so it is an empty routine in the runtime segment with no observable effect.

name: select_variant_from_callback_results
description: Stores a context pointer, writes an audio DMA enable value and runs an init callback. It then calls two query callbacks and compares their results to fixed constants to set a variant flag, then calls a final callback and jumps through a stored pointer.

name: call_indirect_from_table
description: Calls the routine stored at a fixed slot of a context block whose pointer is kept in a global variable, then returns without other work.

name: call_indirect_from_table
description: Calls the routine stored at a fixed slot of a context block whose pointer is kept in a global variable, then returns without other work.

name: install_jump_trampolines
description: Writes an absolute jump opcode and a routine address into two RAM locations, choosing the second target when a variant flag is set, then calls a routine. The trailing bad-instruction data is a decompiler artefact, not behaviour.

name: set_state_and_jump
description: Stores a fixed state word, calls the routine in a fixed slot of a context block, then transfers control through a jump table the decompiler could not recover.

name: set_state_and_jump
description: Stores a different fixed state word, calls the routine in a fixed slot of a context block, then transfers control through a jump table the decompiler could not recover.

name: init_self_referencing_record
description: Stores the record's own address in its first word, sets a fixed set of flag bits in a control word addressed relative to that record, and copies a global value into the record's second word.

name: decrement_counters_set_flags
description: Decrements a longword and two word counters at offsets from the given bases, copies a control word into the destination, sets a fixed set of flag bits in it, writes the second input word, and returns zero.

name: call_routine_return_second_value
description: Calls a routine and then returns the value in the second data register, which the call may have set.

name: call_context_slot_return_pair
description: Calls the routine in a fixed slot of a context block referenced by a global pointer, then returns the two input data values concatenated as a pair.

name: call_context_slot_return_pair
description: Calls the routine in a fixed slot of a context block referenced by a global pointer, then returns the two input data values concatenated as a pair.

name: initialize_copper_and_interrupts
description: Sets the copper list pointer and the background color register, writes a DMA enable value and an interrupt enable mask, installs a handler routine, makes one system trap call, then stores a value and calls a routine three times in turn. The trailing bad-instruction data is a decompiler artefact.

name: store_record_at_pointer
description: Writes a ten-byte value passed on the stack at fixed negative offsets from the pointer kept in a global, as one longword and one word, without changing that pointer.

name: wait_for_sentinel_then_halt
description: Spins until a global word equals the all-ones sentinel, then loops forever with no exit path.

name: wait_for_sentinel_then_halt
description: Spins until a global word equals the all-ones sentinel, then loops forever with no exit path.

name: decrunch_packed_block_backwards
description: Checks a four-character magic tag at the start of a packed block, then unpacks it from the end backwards, copying literal runs and back-references whose lengths are decoded from a bit stream until the output start is reached. The export ends mid-routine, so the later steps are not recovered.

name: parse_hunk_executable_header
description: Checks for the executable header type code, skips the resident-name list, records the table size, and assigns each section a base address by accumulating section sizes. It then dispatches each following record through a table indexed by its type code.

name: return_constant_success
description: Returns the constant one without other work, so callers receive a success value.

name: copy_block_and_zero_fill
description: Copies a counted block of longwords from the source pointer to the destination in the descriptor, then zero-fills the remaining byte count after it, and returns one.

name: copy_block_and_zero_fill
description: Copies a counted block of longwords from the source pointer to the destination in the descriptor, then zero-fills the remaining byte count after it, and returns one.

name: apply_relocation_records
description: Walks a list of relocation records that ends with a zero count; for each entry it adds a base value from the stack-passed section list to the longwords at the listed offsets, patching absolute addresses after loading.

description: Returns zero without other work, so callers receive a zero status.

name: zero_fill_longword_block
description: Reads a count from the first input, then writes zero to that many longwords starting at the destination stored in a descriptor, and returns one.

name: advance_position_in_twelve_steps
description: Splits a linear position into a quotient and remainder by twelve, then walks a count in chunks of at most the remaining row width, calling helper routines for each chunk and returning the resulting position and status.

name: poll_disk_status_reset_units
description: Runs a short polling loop up to three times; when a status bit is set it clears a status word in each of twelve unit records, then writes two control words and returns. The facts show the CIA port used for disk status.

name: configure_disk_controller_registers
description: Writes a sequence of values to the floppy disk controller: adjusts the control word, stores a buffer address in the disk pointer register, and writes the disk sync word and length registers.

name: decode_disk_sector_headers
description: Starts a disk read by setting the sync-word registers, then loops over twelve sector records. It checks each sync word and the header checksum built from odd and even bit-split decoding, returns an error code on a mismatch, and otherwise moves to the next record.

name: wait_for_sector_counter_nonzero
description: Calls a helper, then loops calling a helper until a counter field in the disk state block is non-zero, returning after the second call at the earliest.

name: compute_disk_block_checksum
description: XORs 256 longwords into one accumulator and returns it as the result, with the odd and even bit lanes masked and recombined as the disk checksum format requires.

name: decode_odd_even_longword_block
description: Decodes 128 longwords: for each pair of source longwords it merges the odd and even bit lanes under a sector mask, XORs the result with the previous decoded value, and stores it into the destination array.

name: halve_indexed_table_entry
description: Looks up a word in a global table by index, corrects it with a helper call when it is negative, halves it, and stores a given value and a helper result into destinations.

name: poll_cia_bit_clear_entry
description: Polls a CIA port bit for a bounded number of iterations; when the bit clears it zeroes the table entry for the current index and stores the helper result.

name: compute_cia_drive_control_mask
description: Builds a control byte from the current global value by clearing one bit selected by an index, additionally clearing a second bit when a per-index table flag is set, and returns it.

name: pulse_drive_control_bits
description: Repeats a count-controlled sequence: each step reads a control byte from a helper, optionally clears a bit based on a sign flag, forces the low bit set in the drive control port, and calls a helper.

name: write_control_word_index_bit
description: Writes a fixed word to a control register, then, when a status word is negative, writes a value with one bit derived from an index set in that register.

name: set_cia_port_bit
description: Sets one bit of a CIA port value, with the bit position derived from an index in the frame, and writes the result to the port.

name: wait_for_drive_ready_flag
description: Writes an all-ones value to a control port, then repeatedly calls a helper and spins while a status bit in the port is set, until the helper returns one; returns zero.

name: wait_for_flag_and_result
description: Calls a helper until it returns one, spinning between calls while bit zero of a global word is set. The facts name a timer control register, and the code returns zero once the wait completes.

name: start_ciab_timer_when_idle
description: When bit zero of a global word is clear and the input is not one, writes a three-value control sequence to the CIA timer register; otherwise it does nothing.

name: set_ciab_timer
description: Writes three values to a global variable in sequence, which the facts show as CIA timer register writes.

name: store_two_longs_before_pointer

name: stub_single_instruction_routine

name: poll_ports_then_call_sequence
description: Calls four helpers, then loops calling a helper while two status bits in a global port mirror stay set. After the loop it makes a long run of helper calls and stores a pointer into a global.

name: poll_status_until_ready
description: Repeatedly calls a helper and inspects two status bits in a global port mirror. It returns the helper value when the first bit is clear, returns zero when the helper reports one under the second bit's condition, and otherwise repeats.

name: fill_display_pointer_table
description: Writes five high and low word pairs of an address into a display pointer table, advancing the address by a fixed row stride for each entry, then calls a helper and stores a fixed value into a global.

name: wait_for_helper_completion
description: Calls a helper, then repeatedly calls two helpers in a loop while a condition on a routine address holds, returning once it no longer does.

description: Calls a helper, then calls a context routine with a fixed code; if two status flag bits in the port mirror are both set it spins forever, otherwise it returns the helper result.

name: store_longword_at_masked_address
description: Writes its second input longword to the address formed by masking the first input to a window of about 512 KB, then returns that address split into a word pair with the following word.

name: open_scores_file_if_available
description: Calls a context routine that reports whether the scores file is available and, when it is, calls a second context routine, then returns its two input values. The routine references the text Scores.Dat.

name: run_frame_loop_until_marker
description: Runs a loop that calls several helpers and advances timers and table pointers each pass, ending when a table entry equals the end marker, then copies twelve words of color data into the custom color registers from the background color register. It references the text Scores.Dat, but the loop does not show what that screen does.

name: wait_blitter_return_pair
description: Calls a helper that waits for the blitter to finish, then calls a context routine and returns the two input data values as a pair.

name: patch_words_when_marker_matches
description: Calls a helper and a context routine, then compares a longword in RAM with a fixed marker value and, when it matches, rewrites that word and two others with replacement values. The facts also show a blitter wait is called.

name: update_volume_ramp_run_steps
description: Moves a volume-like byte one step toward a target each time an accumulator carries, flipping a direction flag at the target, then runs the per-channel step routine four times and again four times when a second flag and carry condition hold. The facts list interrupt and DMA register use.

name: step_channel_countdown_table
description: Decrements a per-channel countdown byte; when it reaches zero it reads the next duration from a table, ending the step if that value is zero. Otherwise it advances the channel's table index by two and adds a table entry to a second per-channel byte.

name: update_channel_envelope_step
description: Advances one channel's envelope and modulation state: it calls the countdown routine, scales a table value by a volume byte, applies optional sign and offset adjustments under flag bits, and stores the result as the channel's output word. When the step counter expires it reads the next pair of table entries and updates the channel's pointer and length fields.

name: reset_audio_channel_state
description: Clears five per-channel state bytes, then writes two values to a shared control word, first all bits set and then a low nibble, which the facts show as audio DMA and ADKCON register writes.

name: read_channel_sequence_bytes
description: Reads bytes from a channel's sequence stream; bytes in the top range end the step and save the stream position, while the other values are stored as note or instrument fields or dispatched through a handler table.

name: store_channel_header_and_parse
description: Stores the first byte of a sequence stream into a song-level field and then runs the same sequence byte loop that ends by saving the stream position.

name: init_pitch_slide_and_parse
description: Stores a step value and a count into channel fields, clears the accumulator, and sets the slide flag, then parses the remaining sequence bytes. The update routine adds the step to the accumulator when the count reaches zero.

name: init_channel_oscillator_and_parse
description: Stores two header bytes as oscillator parameters, one used as a phase counter and one doubled as its range, sets the oscillator-enable flag, and then parses the remaining sequence bytes.

name: store_channel_byte_and_parse
description: Stores the first byte of a sequence into a channel field and then runs the same sequence byte loop that ends by saving the stream position.

name: set_channel_flags_and_parse
description: Sets two flag bits in a channel control byte and then parses the sequence bytes until the step ends.

name: clear_channel_control_and_parse
description: Clears a channel control byte and then parses the sequence bytes until the step ends.

name: store_masked_global_and_parse
description: Stores a masked value from the first sequence byte into a global, then parses the rest of the sequence stream. The facts show an audio control register is also involved.

name: tick_channel_sequence_timer
description: Counts down the channel's step timer; while it runs, a ramp flag moves a level byte up or down. When the timer expires it clears the transient flags and resumes parsing the channel's sequence from its saved position.

name: reset_step_and_save_position
description: When the channel's hold flag is clear, it zeroes the channel's extra counter, sets its start count and writes the channel's output byte. It then reloads the step timer from its saved value and stores the current stream position.

name: load_table_entry_into_channel
description: Looks up a table entry at the given index, saves the index in the channel's table position field, stores the looked-up value as the channel's current level, and sets its counter to one.

name: update_channel_sample_pointer_length
description: For a channel whose start delay is running, it counts the delay down, clamps a negative offset to zero on expiry, and writes the sample pointer and word length into the channel's audio hardware slot, then writes a DMA control value.

name: reset_and_load_channel_table
description: Clears the channel state table of sixteen records, marks two global bytes with a full-set sentinel value, then loads four channel start entries from a table selected by the argument, setting each channel's pointer, length and sentinel fields.

name: store_high_word_to_global
description: Stores the high word of the data register into a global and returns, with no other work.

name: clear_twelve_global_words
description: Writes zero to twelve global words in turn, clearing a block of state, and returns with no other work.

name: draw_text_glyphs_to_bitplanes
description: Walks a zero-terminated character string, looking each byte up in a 41-entry glyph table and writing seven rows of glyph bits into four bitplanes at a 44-byte row stride. A negative byte ends the string and records the final column and row, and a zero byte returns the write position.

name: draw_text_glyphs_to_bitplanes
description: Walks a zero-terminated character string, looking each byte up in a 41-entry glyph table and writing seven rows of glyph bits into four bitplanes at a 44-byte row stride. A negative byte ends the string and records the final column and row, and a zero byte returns the write position.

name: run_background_color_sequence
description: A 104-instruction routine that writes the background color register and calls seven helpers. The decompiler produced no pseudo-code, so only the register use and calls are known.

name: setup_copper_list_wait_loop
description: Writes three copper list words, points the first copper list register at them, then runs a loop of up to 700 iterations that calls helpers and waits for a raster line. The loop stops early and sets a failure code if a helper reports a failed check.

name: check_button_status_bits
description: Returns zero when three status bits in a global port mirror are all set and one otherwise. The facts show the fire-button and right and middle button ports.

name: return_flag_after_helper_call
description: Calls a helper, then returns a one in the high half of the result when a global value is non-zero, otherwise it returns the unchanged input.

name: setup_second_copper_loop
description: Initializes a state byte, writes copper and color setup values, sets the first and second copper list pointers, then loops up to 700 times calling helpers and stopping early on a failure. The facts show a raster wait is also called.

name: call_two_stub_routines
description: Calls two tiny routines and returns. The decompiler produced no pseudo-code, so only the calls are known.

name: call_helper_return_pair
description: Calls a helper and returns the two input data values as a pair.

name: build_character_entry_table
description: Fills a table of eight-byte entries with incrementing character codes, fixed flag bytes and words copied from a source table: fifty-four entries, then fifty-two more, then a four-byte terminator.

name: run_name_entry_screen
description: Runs a name-entry loop of up to nine characters over a letter set, with the brace and angle-bracket characters acting as special codes for confirm and delete, and calls a wait routine each frame. The routine references the text PLEASE ENTER YOUR NAME and LAST SCORE.

name: draw_glyph_string_in_mode
description: Draws a zero-terminated string of glyphs into the bitplanes in one of three modes: copying glyph bits into two planes, or combining them with a mask and a state byte. A negative byte ends the string and records the position.

name: stub_single_instruction_routine
description: A single-instruction routine referenced by its address. The decompiler produced no pseudo-code, so only its size and reference type are known.

name: stub_text_reference_routine
description: A 68-instruction routine that references the name-entry text and is called by seven routines. The decompiler produced no pseudo-code, so only its size, calls and references are known.

name: format_eight_nibbles_as_text
description: Writes the eight nibbles of the data register as characters at the output pointer, rotating through the value and replacing leading zero nibbles with spaces, except that the last digit is always written.

name: format_two_nibbles_as_text
description: Writes two digit characters derived from the low byte of the input, rotating through the value and replacing a leading zero digit with a space.

name: call_helper_return_pair
description: Calls a helper and returns the two input data values as a pair.

name: cycle_color_and_rewrite_entries
description: Advances a twelve-bit color value by a fixed step between two bounds on a timer, reversing direction at each end. It then rewrites a list of 128 entries with a character index rotating over ten values and a color word taken from a table.

name: store_slot_and_call_helper
description: Stores a stack-slot longword into a table indexed by the data register, calls a helper, and writes the helper's returned longword back into the slot.

name: copy_slot_and_call_helpers
description: Copies one longword slot into another, calls two helpers and two further routines, then writes an all-ones sentinel to a global.
